---
title: "Data dashboard 2"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center
library(leaflet)

sites <- read.csv("data/sites_metadata.csv")

vars <- c(
  Habitat = "Habitat",
  Island_shore = "Island_shore",
  Distance_from_shore = "Distance_from_shore",
  Distance_from_crest = "Distance_from_crest",
  Watershed_area = "Watershed_area",
  Cleared_area = "Cleared_area"
)

nice_name <- c(
  Habitat = "Habitat",
  Island_shore = "Island shore",
  Distance_from_shore = "Distance from shore",
  Distance_from_crest = "Distance from crest",
  Watershed_area = "Watershed area",
  Cleared_area = "Cleared area"
)

is_discrete <- function(x) is.character(x) || is.factor(x)

make_pal <- function(x) {
  if (is_discrete(x)) {
    colorFactor(palette = "viridis", domain = x, na.color = "transparent")
  } else {
    colorNumeric(palette = "viridis", domain = x, na.color = "transparent")
  }
}

map <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 12)

all_groups <- unname(nice_name)

for (v in vars) {
  vals <- sites[[v]]
  pal <- make_pal(vals)
  grp <- nice_name[[v]]
  
  popup <- paste0(
    "Site ", sites$Site,
    "<hr>",
    grp, ": ", vals
  )
  
  # Add markers to the map with this group
  map <- map %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = sites,
      lng = ~Longitude,
      lat = ~Latitude,
      color = pal(vals),
      radius = 4,
      opacity = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      popup = popup,
      group = grp
    )
}

map %>%
  addLayersControl(
    position = "topleft",
    overlayGroups = all_groups,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  hideGroup(all_groups[-1]) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(paste0("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      var allGroups = ", jsonlite::toJSON(all_groups, auto_unbox = TRUE), ";
      var activeGroup = '", all_groups[1], "';
      
      // When a layer is added (checked), hide all other groups
      map.on('overlayadd', function(e) {
        if (e.name !== activeGroup) {
          // Hide the previously active group
          allGroups.forEach(function(group) {
            if (group === activeGroup) {
              map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
                if (layer.options && layer.options.group === group) {
                  map.removeLayer(layer);
                }
              });
              // Uncheck the checkbox
              var control = map._layersControl;
              if (control && control._container) {
                var label = Array.from(control._container.querySelectorAll('label')).find(function(l) {
                  return l.textContent.trim() === group;
                });
                if (label) {
                  var input = label.querySelector('input[type=\"checkbox\"]');
                  if (input && input.checked) {
                    input.checked = false;
                    map.fire('overlayremove', {name: group});
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          });
          activeGroup = e.name;
        }
      });
    }
  "))
```
